source_events.event_name: Ride to StoneBridge with Pippa and Bubbles
source_events.location: from the river road to StoneBridge and the dock/barge landing
outcomes: Pippa hitchhikes Bubbles the Float Goat to her wagon full of kegs.
Caelynn, Ephanna, Stafl, Baergrom, and Karsemine accept Pippa's ride to StoneBridge.
The group travels by wagon and barge toward StoneBridge.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

source_events.event_name: Recover debris from the broken riverside structure
outcomes: The party helps pull up debris from the broken structure upriver.
Bonogo dives into the water to investigate what was stuck in the fisherman’s net.
Stafl and Baergrom haul the net to the surface and reveal it is part of roof corner beams, not a fish.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

source_events.event_name: Beer and music at the River's Edge Pub
outcomes: Pippa, the party, and Grishna share welcome beers at the River's Edge Pub.
Stafl joins another bard in a jam and impresses the room with his song craft.
The crew retells their Wizard’s Tower Brewery adventure to the evening patrons.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

source_events.location: StoneBridge and the River's Edge Pub
outcomes: The loud drumming on the roof turns out to be torrential rain.
A horrible storm builds rapidly and threatens the town.
Pippa excuses herself to check on Bubbles as the weather deteriorates.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

outcomes: Pippa is found soaked and panicked in rushing floodwater.
She says Bubbles is missing and that the lead has broken.
The party realizes Bubbles is in immediate danger.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

source_events.event_name: Ephanna tries the first mage hand lasso
source_events.location: rock in the flooded river by the pub dock
outcomes: Ephanna uses mage hand to throw a lasso at Bubbles.
Bubbles panics and bites the mage hand.
The first rescue attempt fails and the rope is lost into the water.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

source_events.event_name: Caelynn freezes a platform around Bubbles' rock
source_events.location: flooded river beside the pub dock
outcomes: Caelynn uses ice to freeze the base of the rock.
The frozen ice creates a platform for reaching Bubbles.
The party gains a safer route toward the floating goat.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

source_events.event_name: Bonogo dives after Bubbles and is swept downstream
outcomes: Bonogo dives into the water to rescue Bubbles.
Baergrom loses hold of the rope as the current surges.
Bonogo is carried downstream by the flood and disappears from sight.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

source_events.event_name: Stafl rallies town support and flood defenses
outcomes: Stafl bangs on doors and gathers townfolk to help.
Nets are dropped across the river flow ways.
Stafl helps evacuate residents to the pub on high ground.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

source_events.event_name: Second mage hand lasso reaches Bubbles
outcomes: Ephanna sends mage hand and rope out again to Bubbles.
The second attempt succeeds and lassos Bubbles.
Bubbles is led to Ephanna instead of drifting free.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

source_events.event_name: Karsemine uses Zephyr Strike to track Bonogo
outcomes: Karsemine casts Zephyr Strike and runs down the bank.
She fires arrows at where Bonogo likely was in the current.
Karsemine tries to keep pace with the runaway rescue attempt.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

source_events.event_name: Stafl and Caelynn launch the dinghy after Bonogo
outcomes: Stafl and Caelynn cut loose a dinghy.
They let the river carry the boat after Bonogo.
A lit net is used as a makeshift guide while they pursue the downstream rescue.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

source_events.event_name: Ephanna gets Bubbles to the dock and rides out after the boats
source_events.location: ice path, dock, and rushing river
outcomes: Ephanna and the mage hand coax Bubbles onto the lasso route.
Bubbles crosses the ice path to the dock safely.
Ephanna hops on Bubbles' back and follows after the runaway boats.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md

source_events.event_name: Bonogo is rescued and the town settles
outcomes: Bonogo is rescued from the flood.
The wet adventurers return to the pub to dry off.
StoneBridge is left damp but safe, and the party realizes they have saved Bubbles the Float Goat.
source_events.evidence_id: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 3 - The Stone Bridge Flood.md
